name: bankconv
description: Convert PDF bank and credit card statements into transactions, CSV, OFX, QFX, QBO or Xero CSV with BankConv. Connects to the BankConv remote MCP server; sign in with your BankConv account, no API key needed.

interface.longDescription: BankConv reads PDF bank and credit card statements and returns every transaction: ISO date, description, signed amount and running balance, with the bank, account, currency and statement period. Ask for a file and it gives a download link for CSV, OFX (Xero, Sage, MYOB, QuickBooks Online), QFX (Quicken), QBO (QuickBooks Desktop Web Connect) or Xero CSV. Each PDF page uses one page of your BankConv account. Account numbers in the results sent to ChatGPT are cut to their last four characters, and conversions expire after 24 hours by default. Read-only on your bank: BankConv never connects to a bank account or moves money. Password-protected PDFs are converted on app.bankconv.com instead.
defaultPrompt: Convert this bank statement to a CSV.
Give me a QBO file of my last statement for QuickBooks Desktop.
How many BankConv pages do I have left?
